name: Deepfury's Orders
summary: Beneath the Thandol Span, Deepfury's Orders lie beside the fallen Ol' Rustlocke. Dark Iron dwarves left the crumpled parchment after ambushing the scouting defender.

sections.title: A Grasp Beneath the Span
sections.body: Ol' Rustlocke was a dwarven defender scouting the foundations of the Thandol Span. Dark Iron dwarves cornered and slew him there. Beside his clenched fist lay crumpled orders written by their leader, Deepfury. The orders show a coordinated plot against the bridge between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: Uncovering the Threat
sections.body: When Rhag Garmason receives the orders, they confirm the bridge garrison's worst suspicions. Dark Iron dwarves have planned operations beneath the Thandol Span's stonework. Rhag calls for urgent reinforcements from Ironforge and Stormwind.

faq.answer: Deepfury's Orders are military instructions written by the Dark Iron commander Deepfury. They were found beside Ol' Rustlocke's body beneath the Thandol Span.
The crumpled parchment lay beside Ol' Rustlocke's clenched fist in the cavernous supports beneath the Thandol Span in the northern Wetlands.
Ol' Rustlocke was a dwarven scout stationed at the Thandol Span. He went to investigate strange activity around the bridge supports, where Dark Iron dwarves ambushed him.

aliases: who do i bring orders to
faq.answer: Deepfury's Orders are brought to Rhag Garmason, the dwarven commander holding out at Dun Modr near the Thandol Span. He reads them to judge the Dark Iron threat.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Dark Iron scheming beneath the Thandol Span cuts deep for Ironforge. The span is one of your kingdom's greatest engineering achievements and a vital northern trade link.
As an Alliance member, you see the intercepted orders reveal a sabotage attempt against the main overland route linking Dun Morogh, the Wetlands, and the northern Alliance outposts.
